note: DRY-RUN copy of phase_e_config.json with 2.2.3 (a Phase D release, outside Phase E) as the only version; used only to exercise the analysis on real runner output

slice.exclude_reason: 7 environmental failures: its test plugins are registered only by a development install (entry points)

estimator_common.match: normalized node id (identical to Phase D)
estimator_common.duration: setup + call + teardown seconds as reported by pytest; timeouts = per_test_timeout_s
estimator_common.speed_rule: k = calibration time recorded by B's collect-only call / median calibration time over P's run calls; if k outside the band, all estimates and budgets are multiplied by k (identical to Phase D)

primary.name: F3_mean_newfile_quantile (q=0.99)
primary.description: seen test: its P duration; unseen test in a file with >= 3 seen tests: the mean P duration of that file's seen tests; unseen test in a file with < 3 seen tests (a whole new file): the 99th percentile (type 7) of all P durations
primary.chosen_by: phase_e/dev/select_estimator.py (LOPO on Phase D data, pre-stated criterion)

secondary.name: F10_quantile_newfile_p99 (q_in=0.9)
secondary.description: as primary, but an unseen test in a known file is priced at the 90th percentile of that file's seen P durations
secondary.role: registered secondary: same rules, reported, no confirmatory claim

comparator_phase_d_registered.name: Phase D registered rule (file median, global median)

real_cost.definition: mean over the B timing passes with a record of setup+call+teardown seconds; timeout = per_test_timeout_s
real_cost.missing: a suite test without any B record is charged its estimate and counted (n_imputed_real, a deviation)

budgets.basis: estimated full-suite cost of the pair suite (B collect-only list) under the estimator, after the speed rule; one budget per estimator

policies.charging: every planned test is charged its real cost; nothing is excluded

P1prime.note: every pair's real spend / budget <= 1.25 (implies mean <= 1.25); stricter than Phase D's single-event maximum of 2.0

P2prime.note: median over pairs of |sum est / sum real - 1| <= 0.15 AND at least 80% of analysable pairs within +-25%

environment_exclusion.rule: a pair is excluded (reported) if more than 10% of the slice files have no test in B's collect list or no test record in P's run; decided at lock time from P's run and B's collect list only

registered_descriptive.N1_new_test_coverage: per pair and tier: unseen tests selected by the primary plan (in_file and new_file separately) and the real cost of the unseen tests that were not selected, against the Phase D comparator
registered_descriptive.lane_cost_ratio: real cost of all unseen tests / budget (what an always-run lane would add)

pair_rule: P = the latest final, non-yanked release of the same major version uploaded to PyPI before B; pairs disjoint (no release in two pairs); no release used in Phase D in any role (study or dry run)
